```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    # Every 6 hours at minute 0
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Copy connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors/
          find airbyte-ai-connectors -type f -name "*.md" -exec sh -c '
            for file; do
              dir=$(dirname "$file")
              connector=$(basename "$dir")
              cp "$file" "docs/ai-agents/connectors/$connector/"
            done
          ' sh {} +

      - name: Clean up airbyte-ai-connectors checkout
        run: |
          rm -rf airbyte-ai-connectors

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            This PR syncs AI connector documentation from the source repository.
            
            Auto-merges after CI passes.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
          draft: false
```
